# Average-heartbeat baseline (generated by scripts/baselines.py)

Target: lead I ECG, 0.5-40 Hz, z-scored per record, 500 Hz. Test data: each development person's 'late' part (last 30% of the music record after a 10 s gap, plus the after-music record).

Columns: r = Pearson; rmse in z-units; prd in %; beat_se / beat_ppv = R-peaks found by neurokit2 in the output vs the .atr lead I marks (+-150 ms); r_timing_abs_ms = median |timing error| of matched R-peaks; rr_mae_ms = mean |R-R error| over consecutive matched beats; scg_det_* = the baseline's own SCG beat detector vs the .atr marks (+-100 ms).
